payload.core_mechanism_summary: Enumerate all possible shift vectors within board range, eliminate those that conflict with unattacked cells, then verify consistency with attacked cells.
payload.rationale: The solution iterates over all possible move vectors (i,j) in [-n+1, n-1] and uses set difference to filter impossible ones based on given board markings. It's an exhaustive enumeration over a finite set of candidates, akin to permutation enumeration but not exactly permutations.
